about: Temperature control: power, set-temp, heat on|off, temp, wait-temp, stir, safety-limit, remote, status. Ranges come from each member's contract input schema (in the unit the argument declares); temperatures are shown in °C.

secondary.elma_elmasonics60h: ultrasonic bath with a heater (agitation primary)

not_in_phase_a.radleys_mya4: four heated zones; its runtime is being fixed (F-list) - add as a member with --zone in the reactor package
not_in_phase_a.scp_digiprepms: digestion block: thermal.set_temperature only inside a configured digestion cycle (sample.configured) - digestion class
not_in_phase_a.laboao_cvdltf12p50: CVD tube furnace: set value only with furnace and flange states of a deposition run - coating class
not_in_phase_a.parr_4591, mt_rc1mxhfcal, ika_rv10_digit: temperature is one parameter of their main job (reaction, calorimetry, evaporation, measurement); their classes can reuse this class's set-temp / wait-temp handlers

membership.verbs_not_yet_covered: program (ramp/soak), timer and atmosphere (rh / CO2 / O2); add them here later

set-temp.label: remote control on
set-temp.message: {inst} takes set points from the computer only in remote control mode, which is off.
set-temp.fix: switch it on: `chemlab run {inst} remote on` (manual: OUT commands work only in remote mode).

heat.label: remote control on
heat.message: {inst} starts or stops from the computer only in remote control mode, which is off.
heat.fix: switch it on: `chemlab run {inst} remote on`.

circulation.set_running:PRECONDITION_FAI.message: {inst} cannot start: it needs power, a bath filled and declared by the lab, no alarm and remote mode.
circulation.set_running:PRECONDITION_FAI.fix: check `chemlab run {inst} status` (alarm code, remote) and ask the lab operator if the bath is not set up.

unsupported.stir: no stirrer: the bath is mixed by the circulation pump (`heat on`)

heat: on a circulator, heat on starts the pump and the temperature control (circulation.set_running)
set-temp: the over-temperature cut-off (safety-limit) must stay above the set point

unsupported.remote: no remote/local mode: it takes commands whenever its interface is connected

safety-limit: the safety-circuit screw is turned by hand (safety.set_limit is a physical action)
temp: the plate temperature, or the probe's when a sensor is immersed

unsupported.heat: the oven controls to its set point whenever it is switched on (use `power`)

safety-limit: sets the safety controller to an absolute limit (mode limit); its other mode is an offset above the set point

set-temp.label: no programme running
set-temp.message: a temperature programme is running on {inst}; it owns the set point.
set-temp.fix: wait for it to end, or stop it (`chemlab call {inst} thermal.stop_program`).

unsupported.heat: a plain set point holds while the furnace is on; ramp/soak programmes are not class verbs yet (chemlab call thermal.start_program)
unsupported.safety-limit: the over-temperature limiter is not exposed by the controller

unsupported.heat: the controller holds its set point while on; programmes (program.*) are not class verbs yet

set-temp.label: no disinfection running
set-temp.fix: wait until it has finished (`chemlab run {inst} status`).

unsupported.heat: temperature control is always active while the incubator is on
unsupported.safety-limit: no user safety limit (alarm limits only)

unsupported.heat: the chamber controls to its set point whenever it is on

set-temp: only the temperature changes; humidity and fan keep their set points

unsupported.heat: refrigeration runs whenever the freezer is on
unsupported.safety-limit: the freezer has alarm limits, not a cut-off (chemlab call settings.configure --high_alarm_k ...)

thermal.set_enabled:PRECONDITION_FAILED.message: {inst} cannot heat now: it needs power, the hood closed, no error, and a set point below the safety limit.
thermal.set_enabled:PRECONDITION_FAILED.fix: close the hood (`chemlab call {inst} hood.set_angle --angle_rad 0` if it is open) and check `chemlab run {inst} status`.

safety-limit.label: heating off
safety-limit.message: {inst} takes new safety limits only while heating and shaking are stopped (heating is on).
safety-limit.fix: `chemlab run {inst} heat off`, set the limit, then `heat on` again.

stir.label: fixture installed
stir.message: {inst} has no shaking fixture (platform) installed, so it cannot shake.
stir.fix: ask the lab operator to install a fixture and secure the vessels; temperature control works without it.

thermal.set_enabled:PRECONDITION_FAILED.message: the bath heater of {inst} cannot start: it needs power, liquid in the bath, the drain closed and no error.
thermal.set_enabled:PRECONDITION_FAILED.fix: have the bath filled (lab operator) and the drain closed, switch it on, then `heat on`.

unsupported.stir: no stirrer (ultrasound is the agitation class's verb)
